## Background

Our deploys used to run nightly, and every deploy was a coin flip.

## The new pipeline

We moved to continuous deployment with canary releases and automatic rollbacks.

## Results

Deploy frequency went from weekly to twenty times a day, and failed deploys dropped 90%.

## Backpressure

Backpressure is when a fast producer overwhelms a slow consumer. The consumer signals the producer to slow down. This prevents unbounded queues.
---

This section explains an important concept — suggest how to make it land better for readers.
